summary:
The Journey is a Scratch-coded game starring Golf, one of the two golf balls left behind on the Moon by the Apollo 14 team, who is looking for Ball, his brother. On the way he meets 3 Abandoned Lunar Equipment, who teach him about letting go and accepting they'll never return to Earth - and that's okay!
(Unfinished :c)
details: It was meant to be an integrate visual novel with puzzle and dodging mechanics. In reality, it is simply a dodging game with a 10 HP limit. It was coded using Scratch MIT. The project intended to talk not only about the abandoned NASA equipment on the Moon, but also about their significance for space travel progress, showing they had all completed their purpose, tasks, and lifetimes, and; despite it being bittersweet; we must let them go and honor their memory.
